text: The authors define gaps between answer generation (G), answer discrimination/critiqueability (D) and answer critiquing (C), each measured as how much one task's performance exceeds another's. The GC gap reflects effectiveness of self-critiquing, the GD gap the model's ability to know its answers are poor, and the CD gap its ability to give human-understandable critiques of answers it 'knows' are flawed.
title: Generator-discriminator-critique (GDC) gaps, including the critique-discrimination gap
